Ig1_Q124.description: Ig1 I122/F147/Y148, selected from the top-ranked Q124-centred heuristic patch. Three exposed preferred anchors (relative SASA 0.74/0.42/0.57); patch centroid 15.8 A from N114, with 31% of patch members inside the assumed sequon exclusion radius. Accessibility is not established. Proximity to ligand-implicated positions motivates testing competition, not assuming antagonism. Existing job 1573761 may finish. Do not repeat this protein-only footprint unchanged: two current filter-passing variants overlap N114 carbohydrate.

Ig1_E152.description: E152-centred patch, narrowed to I122/Y148. Retains proximity to the Gokul Ig1 reference while removing F147 as a preferred anchor. This does not exclude F147 contacts or guarantee ligand compatibility. The patch has zero members within the assumed 15 A sequon radius, but requires actual glycan-volume avoidance during generation and native-pose screening.
Ig1_E152.selection_evidence: Existing intact-receptor triage: score 0.612; 9 patch residues; nearest sequon N114 at centroid distance 19.4 A; observed patch-glycan minimum 12.32 A. Heuristic only.

Ig2_L270.description: L270-centred Ig2 patch with L270 as the sole preferred anchor, retained with the full Ig pair. Higher-scoring I283/S285-centred patches extend into FNIIIa and are outside the active scope. This patch is glycan-risky and ligand-proximal, so it is an exploratory alternative, not an established superior epitope. L196 is 13.57 A from N170 by CA distance and is excluded by the conservative glycan mask; it is not a preferred anchor.
Ig2_L270.selection_evidence: Existing intact-receptor triage: score 0.538; nearest sequon N170 at centroid distance 17.4 A; 36% of patch residues within the assumed sequon radius; observed patch-glycan minimum 8.86 A.
